purpose: Compare the complete EAzami 7-trait x 9-environment exploratory atlas with the matching rows of the frozen Azami Chapter 1 full-27 x full-nine exploratory atlas only after EAzami discovery and topology gating are frozen.

azami_source.role: frozen external Chapter 1 comparison surface, not a Chapter 2 row-selection rule

primary_comparison.eazami_effect: ML branch-aware beta on exact Japan38 subset
primary_comparison.why: Both are species/taxon-level directions. Azami within-taxon coefficients are retained separately as scale context and are not treated as the same estimand.

measurement_boundary.orientation: Both chapters use the image-derived signed head-axis angle relative to EXIF-oriented image vertical. This is not a gravity-referenced inclinometer angle.
measurement_boundary.shape: EAzami legacy shape_* names map to the same Azami outline estimands renamed capitulum_outline_* / capitulum_width_profile_cv in the v2 endpoint contract.
measurement_boundary.colour: Lab lightness and chroma use the same frozen image-measurement definitions.

claim_boundary: Azami was not used to select EAzami rows or predictors.
Direction concordance is descriptive cross-study consistency, not replication of one coefficient because taxon sets and estimators differ.
Direction discordance is a scale/lineage result, not proof of driver switching.
Azami within-taxon and EAzami species-level effects are not the same estimand.
Neither concordance nor discordance establishes natural selection, adaptation or historical causation.
